review_scope: Static audit of scripts/q1_3/report_two_configuration_robustness.py plus completed-artifact checks available before the aggregate two-configuration trials.csv is rebuilt. No report script or runner was modified.

aggregate_input_state.consequence: Full 16 condition by 100 trial report statistics, final recommendation rows, and the 15 shared-condition cells were not recomputed in this review. The report's default mode is designed to refuse that partial input.

static_checks.name: coverage_gate
static_checks.evidence: Default report mode requires exactly 1616 rows, 1600 random rows, 16 table-1 rows, each gain-condition group to contain trials 0..99 exactly once, and no unknown gain-condition pair.

static_checks.name: rates_and_event_denominators
static_checks.evidence: Stop, terminal precision, and joint-success rates use every random trial in the group. First and sustained threshold times retain missing values and report hit counts separately; a budget value of 560 is never substituted for a missing first event.

static_checks.name: gain_0.5_vs_gain_1_pairing
static_checks.evidence: The gain bootstrap intersects trial IDs within each condition, resamples paired trial differences, and restricts first-event time contrasts to trials where both events exist.

static_checks.name: main_vs_two_configuration_pairing
static_checks.evidence: The three-way comparison reads main only from outputs/q1_3/robustness/trials.csv, is restricted to the five original shared conditions, intersects matching trial IDs, and labels the main source in every paired row.

static_checks.name: recommendation_interpretation
static_checks.evidence: conclusion_lines ranks only gain 0.5 versus gain 1 within each condition by a stated point-estimate ordering. It does not use bootstrap intervals as a decision rule. The prose should call this a contract-specific ordered candidate, cite the paired-bootstrap table, and avoid describing overlapping finite-sample differences as a statistically established gain advantage. The exact-condition special case appropriately uses observed stop cost after both gains complete every trial.

final_acceptance_pending: After the 1616-row trials.csv exists, rerun the report in default mode and independently recompute the 15 main-common method-condition cells from raw CSV.
Check the produced gain and main paired-bootstrap CSVs retain the expected 100 shared trial IDs for all applicable full groups.
Review recommendation wording against the final paired interval rows.
